question: 10 women do half of the total work in 20 days. How many more women will be required to complete the remaining work in 10 days?
solution:
**Given:**

10 women can complete half of the total work in 20 days.

Half of the total work is 10 × 20 = 200 units.

Total work = 400 units

Remaining work = 400 – 200 = 200 units
